statement: Assume Assumption 2.3. Let (T0, G0) be an ordinary rational dlt fourfold pair with reduced boundary, on a normal irreducible globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler space. Assume that KT0 has a semipositive singular metric on a Cartier power. The boundary may be empty. There is a nonextracting bimeromorphic map T0 99K T such that: (i) T is normal, compact Kähler, globally strongly Q-factorial, and klt for zero boundary; KT remains pseudo-effective with such a semipositive metric. (ii) The pushforward G is reduced, (T, G) is lc, and the actual rational line A = KT + G is analytically nef. There is a rational t0 ∈ [0, 1) such that (T, tG) is klt and KT + tG is analytically nef for every rational t ∈ [t0, 1). (iii) There is a projective crepant dlt modification h : (V, D) −→ (T, G), J := KV + D = h∗ A, (150) where V is normal, compact Kähler, and globally strongly Q-factorial, and D is reduced. The line J is analytically nef. If G ̸= 0, then D ̸= 0. (iv) On a simultaneous smooth compact Kähler projective resolution µ : M → V of the displayed models and boundaries, the line µ∗J has a semipositive metric with minimal singularities and zero Lelong numbers everywhere. The construction uses the fourfold MMP assumption only for ordinary effective klt pairs with pseudo-effective adjoint.
